presentation_summary: Five days of fever, headache, and diffuse erythematous rash/erythroderma
Initial exam showed BP 86/55 mmHg, HR 81/min, SpO2 95% on room air, fever, diffuse erythematous rash, and pulmonary crackles
Initial labs showed WBC 13.62 x10^3/uL, neutrophils 11.73 x10^3/uL, eosinophils 1.02 x10^3/uL, and CRP 148.3 mg/L
Further evaluation showed eosinophils 1.81 x10^3/uL, AST 210 U/L, ALT 213 U/L, procalcitonin 0.39 ng/mL, ESR 29 mm/h, sterile blood/urine cultures, pulmonary micronodules, and mediastinal lymph nodes
Review of history revealed metronidazole exposure for dental abscess 12 days earlier; RegiSCAR score was 6
